# `ceangal`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/mod.almd; do not edit. -->

_The app: run, focus, keyboard, viewport, clipboard._

ceangal — app runtime: event dispatch, layout, paint, hit testing.

An app is a record of closures. `run` stores it and enters the host loop;
the host then calls `dispatch` (docs/abi.md §2) for every event. Each
handled event marks the UI dirty; the next frame event rebuilds the view
tree, lays it out and paints it through snaidhm.

```almide
import ceangal
```

### `App`

```almide
type App = {
  view: () -> v.View,
  background: snaidhm.Color,
  on_key: (Int, Int, Int) -> Bool,     // (phase, key, mods) -> handled
  on_text: (Int, String) -> Bool,      // (kind, text) -> handled
  on_frame: (Float) -> Bool,           // (time ms) -> wants another frame
  on_result: (Int, Int, Bytes) -> Unit, // async request (id, status, body)
}
```

An app: its view (called whenever the UI is redrawn) and handlers for
what views do not handle themselves. Build it with `app(view)` and the
setters below, start it with `run`:

  effect fn main() -> Unit = ceangal.run(ceangal.app(view) |> ceangal.background(BG))

### `app`

```almide
pub fn app(view: () -> v.View) -> App
```

An app that draws `view()` on a white background and handles no keys,
text, frames or results itself.

### `background`

```almide
pub fn background(a: App, c: snaidhm.Color) -> App
```

The colour behind the views (and under the safe-area insets).

### `on_key`

```almide
pub fn on_key(a: App, f: (Int, Int, Int) -> Bool) -> App
```

Keys: f(phase, key, mods), true = handled. Phase 0 down, 1 up, 2 repeat;
key codes in docs/abi.md §2.2; read mods with has_shift, is_shortcut….
Shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+…) reach the app first, except the editing ones a
text view owns (select all, copy, cut, undo, redo); other keys only when
the focused view did not take them.

### `on_text`

```almide
pub fn on_text(a: App, f: (Int, String) -> Bool) -> App
```

Text the focused view did not take: f(kind, text), true = handled. Kind
0 commit, 1 IME preedit, 2 preedit end, 3 paste.

### `on_frame`

```almide
pub fn on_frame(a: App, f: (Float) -> Bool) -> App
```

Called every frame with the clock (ms) while it returns true: animations.

### `on_result`

```almide
pub fn on_result(a: App, f: (Int, Int, Bytes) -> Unit) -> App
```

The answer to an asynchronous host request (an HTTP fetch, a file picker):
f(id, status, body).

### `set_background`

```almide
pub fn set_background(c: snaidhm.Color) -> Unit
```

Change the running app's background (the colour around the views, e.g.
under the safe-area insets) — for apps that switch themes.

## Runtime state

### `A11Y_VALUE_MS`

```almide
let A11Y_VALUE_MS
```

a11y values (editor text…) are refreshed at most every A11Y_VALUE_MS; in
between the last ones are reused, and one trailing frame catches up.

### `run`

```almide
pub fn run(a: App) -> Unit
```

Start the app: the host opens its window (or page, or activity) and runs
the event loop; on the desktop this returns when the window closes.

### `invalidate`

```almide
pub fn invalidate() -> Unit
```

Ask for a new frame (state changed outside an event handler).

## Toasts

### `toast`

```almide
pub fn toast(text: String) -> Unit
```

Show `text` for a few seconds (of frame time: the host's clock) in a
bubble at the bottom of the window.
Screen readers announce it: it is a status (role 26), a polite live
region.

## Popups

### `open_popup`

```almide
pub fn open_popup(key: String, index: Int) -> Unit
```

Open the popup of the control with `key` (one at a time), with entry
`index` highlighted (-1 = none). A press outside the popup and its
control closes it.

pub fn close_popup() -> Unit
```

Close the open popup.

pub fn popup_highlight() -> Int
```

The highlighted entry of the open popup (-1 = none).

## Dispatch (docs/abi.md §2)

### `dispatch`

```almide
pub fn dispatch(kind: Int, a: Int, b: Int, x: Float, y: Float, z: Float, w: Float) -> Int
```

The host's entry point: every event comes through here (docs/abi.md §2).
Apps do not call it; tests can, to drive an app without a host.

### `asset`

```almide
pub fn asset(name: String) -> Bytes?
```

A file bundled with the app (ceangal.toml `assets`): `name` is its path
inside an assets directory ("data/words.txt"). None when there is no
such file.

### `asset_text`

```almide
pub fn asset_text(name: String) -> String?
```

A bundled text file (UTF-8), none when there is none.

### `open_url`

```almide
pub fn open_url(url: String) -> Unit
```

Open `url` in the system browser (a new tab on the web).

### `set_title`

```almide
pub fn set_title(title: String) -> Unit
```

The window's title (the page's on the web; phones show none).

### `save_file`

```almide
pub fn save_file(name: String, data: Bytes) -> Int
```

Offer `data` to the user to save as `name`: a save dialog on the desktop,
a download on the web, the share sheet on iOS (Save to Files, AirDrop…),
the shared Downloads folder on Android. Returns a request id; `on_result` gets it with
status 200 when it was saved (the body is the path), 499 when the user
cancelled, 0 when it failed (the body is why).

### `open_text_file`

```almide
pub fn open_text_file() -> Int
```

Ask the user for a text file: the system picker (the document picker on
iOS; Android has none yet and answers 0). Returns a request id;
`on_result` gets it with status 200 and the contents, 499 when the user
cancelled, 0 when it failed.

### `copy_text`

```almide
pub fn copy_text(s: String) -> Unit
```

Put `s` on the system clipboard.
